facts.fact: NIRA says its Partner Management System, for secure identity verification using the National Identification Register, is fully operational and ready for eligible institutions that complete onboarding.
NIRA reported progress in onboarding institutions onto its Partner Management System for identity verification against the National Identification Register.
NIRA runs both birth registration (issuing birth certificates) and the National Identification Numbers, one body handling both, according to its registrar Claire Ollama.

UGA.note: No count or share of people enrolled is given.
NINs are said to be needed by every child but the article does not say a NIN is issued at birth registration.
No statement on who operates or owns the system.
No public register keyed on the NIN is stated.

facts.fact: NIRA issues National Identification Numbers, free for eligible applicants, and keeps the National Identification Register.
